# Vegetation Base Textures

Source: https://opengameart.org/content/paramecijs-vegetation-base-texture-pack

License: CC0 / public domain.

Imported subset:

- `vegetation_fern_01.png`
- `vegetation_fern_08.png`
- `vegetation_smallplant_03.png`
- `vegetation_smallplant_21.png`
- `vegetation_tree_branch_10.png`
- `vegetation_tree_branch_14.png`
- `vegetation_tree_branch_16b.png`
- `vegetation_tree_branch_25.png`
- `vegetation_clover_02.png`

Generated Anemora cutouts:

- `*_anemora_cutout.png`

The generated cutouts keep the CC0 source imagery but alpha-key the remaining photo backdrop colors so the billboard cards read as foliage instead of rectangular plates.

Usage intent: transparent vegetation billboard cards for HD2D nature uplift, including understory fern/small-plant cards and branch/leaf cards layered around imported tree silhouettes.
